experiment_data.hypothesis: TCN σ sensitivity test: same as exp_027 (Gaussian noise on dt_embedding during imagination) but with σ=0.2 instead of 0.5. Tests whether smaller noise magnitude is sufficient to disrupt dt-specific value bias. If σ=0.5 works but σ=0.2 doesn't → noise magnitude matters; if both work → method is robust to σ choice.
